headline: The PCB on Saturday added Aamir Jamal and three uncapped players, Mohammad Tayyab Arif, Ali Shabbir and Saqib Khan, to Pakistan's 16-member Test squad for the two-match series against Sri Lanka, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Aamir Jamal aur 3 uncapped players squad mein shamil

caption:
Pakistan Test squad mein 4 naye khiladi shamil!
Dawn ke mutabiq PCB ne Saturday ko Sri Lanka ke khilaf 2 Test matches ki series ke liye Aamir Jamal aur 3 uncapped players Mohammad Tayyab Arif, Ali Shabbir aur Saqib Khan ko squad mein shamil kar liya, jis ke baad squad 16 players ka ho gaya. Pehla Test Monday se Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium mein aur doosra 17 se 21 November tak Lahore ke Gaddafi Stadium mein hoga.
Naye khiladiyon mein se aap kis se sab se zyada umeed rakhte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
